solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: The never ending round

parts.note: a round shape with no end at all, the line simply returning on itself

explanation.surface: It sounds like a weary complaint about an endless cycle of work or drinks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Round' reads as a round of duties or drinks, but here it is a literal round figure whose line never ends.
explanation.definitionFit: A closed curved line has no start or finish, so it is the shape that literally never ends.

clue.text: Make a reduction and it's a bargain

definitions.meaning: an agreement struck between two parties

explanation.surface: A shopper is told that a price cut means a good deal.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means shrink or tighten; the noun is a binding agreement or deal between parties.

clue.text: Top Gun

definitions.meaning: a spinning top is something that turns round and round
a pistol with a rotating cylinder of chambers

explanation.walkthrough: The clue borrows the film title Top Gun; split it into two words, each defining the answer separately.
explanation.definitionFit: A spinning toy is a thing that rotates, and a handgun with a turning cylinder bears the same name.

clue.text: Number taking turn at party game

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty
a U-turn, so U stands for a turn
a do is an informal word for a party

explanation.surface: Someone holding a number waits for their turn in a party game.
explanation.walkthrough: L is fifty in Roman numerals; U comes from a U-turn; DO is British slang for a party.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a simple board game played with dice and counters, popular with children.

clue.text: Given credit for having made headway

definitions.meaning: lent money ahead of time, as a loan or payment up front

explanation.surface: Someone is praised for making progress on a task.
explanation.definitionFit: Money paid up front is lent ahead of time, and a thing that has moved forward has progressed.

clue.text: Mayonnaise gets lower rating

parts.note: mayonnaise is a salad dressing
down means lower, as in going down

explanation.surface: A food review marks a mayonnaise down to a poorer score.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rating' looks like a score, but it is the noun from the verb 'rate', to scold someone angrily.
explanation.definitionFit: To rate someone is an old verb for berating them, so a rating is a severe telling-off.

clue.text: Lake in rising resort in the mountains

indicators.note: the lake's letter goes inside the resort word
in a down entry, rising means the word is read from bottom upwards

parts.note: a spa is a health resort
L is the standard abbreviation for lake on maps

explanation.surface: A lake sits inside a resort high up in the mountains.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' turns SPA into APS, and 'in' puts L inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: The range across Switzerland, France, Italy and Austria is the best-known European mountain chain.

clue.text: Tom let loose on the ranch

definitions.text: Tom let loose on the ranch

parts.note: a tom is a male cat

indicators.note: letters let loose are freed to fall into a new order

explanation.surface: A tomcat is allowed to roam freely around a ranch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loose' signals the shuffle of 'let'; read whole, the clue also pictures the herd roaming a ranch.
explanation.definitionFit: Cows and steers are the livestock that wander a ranch, so the whole picture defines the herd.

clue.text: Pot red by mistake — it's too much!

indicators.note: letters placed by mistake end up in a wrong, scrambled order

explanation.surface: A snooker player pots the red by accident and groans that it is excessive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by mistake' rearranges the letters of POT RED. In snooker, potting a red ball is a basic shot.
explanation.definitionFit: The French borrowing means superfluous or unwelcome, literally more than is wanted.

clue.text: Retired chap in an American state

indicators.note: something retired goes back, so the assembled letters read backwards
the chap's name goes inside the short word an

parts.note: taken as written
Dave is a typical man's name standing for any chap

explanation.surface: A retired man is living in a state of the USA.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Retired' applies to everything after it, the chap and 'an' together, not just the chap.
explanation.definitionFit: This western US state is home to Las Vegas and Reno.

clue.text: Continue to look after a small bird

parts.note: to keep something is to look after it
a tit is a small songbird

explanation.surface: Someone is urged to go on caring for a little bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means persist or carry on with an effort without stopping.

clue.text: For a time, it naturally puts us completely in the dark

definitions.text: For a time, it naturally puts us completely in the dark

parts.words: For a time, it naturally puts us completely in the dark
parts.note: a natural event in which the moon fully blocks the sun for a few minutes

explanation.walkthrough: 'In the dark' suggests ignorance, but here it is literal darkness caused by nature.
explanation.definitionFit: When the moon covers the whole solar disc, daylight vanishes for a short spell.

clue.text: Register the sound of a drum

explanation.surface: A clerk notes down the beating of a drum.
explanation.definitionFit: A list of names is called by this word, as is a rapid run of drumbeats.

clue.text: Brag about a squash shot

definitions.meaning: a stroke in squash played off a side wall

explanation.surface: A player shows off about a stroke on the squash court.
explanation.definitionFit: To show off is a familiar sense; squash players also use the word for an angled side-wall stroke.

clue.text: A singer the French turn to

indicators.note: the French article is turned round to read backwards

parts.note: la is French for the, in its feminine form
taken as written

explanation.surface: A singer is someone the French turn to for help.
explanation.walkthrough: French has two words for 'the'; the feminine one is needed here, and 'turn' acts on it alone.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a voice part between soprano and tenor, and also a person singing it.

clue.text: Late entry by monarch causes great apprehension

indicators.note: the monarch's letter makes its entry into the other word

parts.note: the late means dead
R stands for rex or regina, king or queen

explanation.surface: A monarch arriving late at an event causes much anxiety.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entry by' puts R inside DEAD.
explanation.definitionFit: A deep fear of what is to come is great apprehension.

clue.text: Employed during practice

parts.note: in means during, as in 'in the night'
use means custom or practice

explanation.surface: Someone is hired while doing a training session.
explanation.definitionFit: Something being employed is currently being used or occupied.

clue.text: Yet a fog-horn may give it

definitions.text: Yet a fog-horn may give it

parts.words: Yet a fog-horn may give it
parts.note: a fog-horn sounds in murky weather, yet its signal is plain and unmistakable

explanation.walkthrough: The joke is the contrast: a horn used only when visibility is poor still gives a plain signal.
explanation.definitionFit: An unambiguous alert is what a fog-horn gives, despite the murk.

clue.text: Made up ground

explanation.surface: Something has been invented on solid footing.
explanation.definitionFit: A face dusted with cosmetics is made up, and spices crushed fine are ground.

clue.text: Abuse one's urge to be magnamimous

indicators.note: to abuse the letters is to mistreat them, knocking them into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone is told to misuse their impulses in order to be big-hearted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Abuse' rearranges ONESURGE; the 's of 'one's' gives a letter S here. The clue prints 'magnamimous' for magnanimous.
explanation.definitionFit: Being big-hearted and free with gifts or forgiveness is a close synonym of lavish kindness.

clue.text: I'd please cook with creation of multi-coloured trifles

indicators.note: the letters are used to create something new, a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A cook offers to make colourful sweet trifles for someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cook' looks like the anagram signal but its letters are needed; 'creation of' rearranges I'D PLEASE COOK. A trifle is also a British layered dessert.
explanation.definitionFit: This toy tube of mirrors and coloured glass is a trifle, a small plaything, of many colours.

clue.text: Is included among those who are against rackets

indicators.note: the word is placed among, inside, the other letters

parts.note: the noes are the voters against a motion
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone joins the protesters who oppose shady rackets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rackets' suggests crime or tennis, but it means din; 'those who are against' are the noes in a parliamentary vote.
explanation.definitionFit: A racket is a loud din, so plural rackets are loud sounds.

clue.text: Bring up fish on front of boat

indicators.note: the front of a word is its first letter

parts.note: a roach is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: An angler hauls a fish up onto the bow of a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: To raise a subject in conversation is to introduce or mention it.

clue.text: They move a boat across water or round a point

definitions.text: They move a boat across water

indicators.note: the two letters go round the single letter, enclosing it

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
S is south, a compass point

explanation.surface: Things propel a boat over the water or around a headland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' puts OR around A, then S, a compass point, follows. 'Point' looks like a headland in the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Rowers pull these wooden blades through the water to drive a boat along.

clue.text: Many acts are beastly offensive

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, so many
acts of parliament are laws

explanation.surface: Lots of deeds are said to be horribly insulting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Offensive' is read as a noun: an animal's means of attack.
explanation.definitionFit: An animal's sharp nails are its weapons of attack, its offensive arsenal.

clue.text: Side having the advantage

explanation.surface: The team holds the upper hand.
explanation.definitionFit: A border or rim is this word, and a small lead over rivals is too.

clue.text: An encore from the male chorus

indicators.note: the letters are taken from within the words that follow

explanation.surface: A male voice choir sings one more song for the crowd.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' takes the letters out of malE CHOrus.
explanation.definitionFit: A repeated sound coming back is like an encore, a repeat performance.

clue.text: An overhead light

parts.note: a ring of light shown above the head of a saint or angel

explanation.walkthrough: 'Overhead light' suggests a ceiling lamp; here it is a glow over someone's head.
explanation.definitionFit: Saints in paintings wear a glowing ring floating just above the head.

clue.text: Main work of an artist

parts.note: the main is the sea, so a painting of the sea

explanation.walkthrough: 'Main' looks like principal, but it is an old word for the sea, as in the Spanish Main.
explanation.definitionFit: A painting showing the ocean is an artist's picture of the main.

clue.text: Bob all set for musical party?

parts.note: Hair is a famous 1960s rock musical
a do is an informal word for a party

explanation.surface: A man named Bob is ready for a show-tune party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bob' looks like a man's name, but it is a short haircut; 'all set' hints at set hair.
explanation.definitionFit: A bob is a style of haircut cut level around the head.

clue.text: Drinking vessel

parts.note: a tall sherry or beer glass, and also a sailing ship, a vessel that is in a sense drinking the sea

explanation.walkthrough: Read plainly it is a glass; read again, a vessel is a ship, and this word names both.
explanation.definitionFit: This word is a large glass for sherry or beer and also a two-masted sailing ship.

clue.text: When speaking, gathers crowds

indicators.note: the word is to be heard, not read, so its sound counts

parts.note: hoards means gathers and stores up

explanation.surface: When someone talks, crowds gather round.
explanation.walkthrough: 'When speaking' signals that HOARDS is heard, giving a word with the same sound.
explanation.definitionFit: Large unruly throngs of people are crowds.
